name: Rizel
source:
Juliette's close aide.

She comes from a family of distinguished knights who have served the royal family for generations. She is dignified and well mannered.

She has absolute confidence in her family background and swordsmanship.

She is kind to others and strict with herself. She never breaks his own code of conduct.

She sometimes annoys the people around her, including the main character...?

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/q_bon/chara/gense.html]official site[/url]]
